account_source.title: Set up Door PINs
account_source.description: This wizard imports an already registered lock and its installed Bluetooth key. Full factory registration, key calibration, and keypad pairing are not implemented. Your account token and password are used only during this setup and are not saved.

account.title: Sign in to August
account.description: Imports an already registered lock and its installed Bluetooth key. Your password and account token are used only during this setup and are not saved.

verification.title: Verify your August account
verification.description: Enter the verification code sent by August.

connect.title: Connect {name} locally
connect.description: Keep your Bluetooth proxy near the lock and close the August app. Continue to verify its installed key and configure local HA access. This does not move the deadbolt.

error.invalid_auth: August rejected the account sign-in request. This may be an account, login-method, or API-access restriction. It does not indicate a Bluetooth failure.
error.cannot_connect: Could not complete this step. Try again after checking the connection.
error.invalid_code: The verification code was not accepted.
error.invalid_selection: Select a valid option from the list.
error.no_offline_key: This lock has no installed offline key available to this account. Factory setup and key provisioning are not yet supported by this wizard.
error.account_connection_failed: Home Assistant could not reach August’s account service. This step does not use Bluetooth.
error.account_response_changed: August returned an account response this version could not interpret. No Bluetooth operation was attempted. A diagnostic with the failure stage and exception type is in HA’s logs; credentials are withheld.
error.account_service_error: August account sign-in could not complete. Check the sanitized diagnostic in HA’s logs. This step does not use Bluetooth.
error.account_endpoint_unavailable: August’s account endpoint is unavailable for this sign-in method. This step does not use Bluetooth.
error.invalid_account_request: August rejected the account request. Check email versus phone sign-in and, for phone, use the international country code.
error.rate_limited: August is rate-limiting sign-in. Wait before trying again.
error.bluetooth_connection_failed: The lock could not be reached over Bluetooth. Keep the proxy near the lock and the August app closed, then retry.
error.bluetooth_auth_failed: The installed key was rejected by the lock. Refresh its provisioned key; this is separate from August account sign-in.
error.no_connectable_device: No connectable Bluetooth device was found at this address.
error.enrollment_failed: Local enrollment failed at stage '{stage}'. No key was confirmed as enrolled. The sequence is experimental and has not been verified end-to-end. Check HA logs for the error type; secrets are withheld.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Door PINs is already configured. Use Configure to reconnect its lock.
abort.no_account_locks: August returned no owner-accessible locks. Check the account; this wizard cannot yet register a factory-reset lock.
abort.bluetooth_setup_failed: The HA Bluetooth setup could not finish. Check Yale Access Bluetooth.
abort.different_lock: Reconnect the same lock selected for Door PINs.
abort.invalid_selection: Select a valid option from the list.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not complete this step. Try again after checking the connection.
abort.invalid_auth: August rejected the sign-in or the installed Bluetooth key. Check your sign-in method and account details.
abort.account_connection_failed: Home Assistant could not reach August’s account service. This step does not use Bluetooth.
abort.account_response_changed: August returned an account response this version could not interpret. No Bluetooth operation was attempted. A diagnostic with the failure stage and exception type is in HA’s logs; credentials are withheld.
abort.account_service_error: August account sign-in could not complete. Check the sanitized diagnostic in HA’s logs. This step does not use Bluetooth.
abort.account_endpoint_unavailable: August’s account endpoint is unavailable for this sign-in method. This step does not use Bluetooth.
abort.invalid_account_request: August rejected the account request. Check email versus phone sign-in and, for phone, use the international country code.
abort.rate_limited: August is rate-limiting sign-in. Wait before trying again.
